findings.summary: pingTimer is declared but never assigned the setInterval id, so clearInterval on close never cancels it.
findings.mechanism: `setInterval(function(){...},15000)` return value is discarded instead of being stored in `pingTimer`. On `ws.onclose`, `clearInterval(pingTimer)` is called with `pingTimer` still `undefined`, which is a no-op. Each reconnect (triggered by the existing `setTimeout(connect,3000)` retry loop) calls `connect()` again, creating a brand-new interval that also never gets cleared — so ping loops accumulate across reconnects, sending duplicate pings and leaking timers indefinitely. This is precisely the concurrent-ping-loop bug the change was supposed to prevent.
